OfferPage.subtitle: Find a moment for yourself. Choose a therapy tailored to the needs of your body and mind.

services.title: START HERE - First Visit
services.description:
Start here. This treatment is the perfect first step. Often, the pain you feel is the result of tensions you are not even aware of. That is why the first session is so important. A full body massage allows us to assess your body, identify hidden tension patterns, and find the true source of the problem. The treatment includes: 
• 60 minutes of full body massage tailored to your needs 
• 15 minutes of consultation, including a health interview and action plan. The consultation time is added to the massage, so you don't lose precious time on the table.

services.title: Classic Massage - Full body, face, and head
services.description: A unique experience that cares for body and soul, providing relaxation on many levels. This holistic therapy combines classic and deep tissue massage techniques, reaching trigger points to release tensions and blockages. Face massage helps release emotional tension and improves sleep, while head massage makes relaxation incredibly deep. Treat yourself to the luxury of regeneration and psychosomatic renewal.

services.title: Classic Massage - Full body
services.description: An excellent starting point for anyone beginning their journey to healing. A 60-minute full body massage opens your eyes to how many areas of our body need attention (often where we don't feel direct pain). It allows you to create a personalized action plan on the path to health - physical and emotional balance. It improves circulation, regulates stress, and deeply relaxes.

services.title: Classic Massage - Back, neck, and shoulders
services.description: A massage with elements of trigger point therapy focusing on the back, neck, and shoulders. The perfect choice for people leading an intensive lifestyle and those who spend many hours behind a desk. Effectively releases muscle tension, focusing on relaxing stress points around the shoulder blades. Provides quick relief, improves flexibility, and restores a sense of lightness.

services.title: Classic Massage - Face, head, neck, and shoulders
services.description: A technique that brings relief to people suffering from migraines, tension headaches, and bruxism (unconscious teeth grinding). Focuses on tired muscles. A series of treatments is recommended to maintain the effects. Initially, a so-called 'healing crisis' may occur, but regular therapy improves circulation, oxygenates cells, and significantly improves sleep quality.

services.title: Deep tissue elements - Back, neck, and shoulders
services.description: A short but intensive session focused on a specific problem. A quick way to release tension and reduce stress accumulating in the neck and shoulders. A qualified therapist will also use stretching techniques to increase the range of motion. Treat yourself to a moment of regeneration during a break from daily duties.

services.title: Extended Classic Massage - Full body, face, and head
services.description: A full two hours of uninterrupted luxury for your body and mind. A holistic therapy with the utmost attention to every detail. A seamless combination of techniques reaching the deepest layers of tissue. Allows you to completely disconnect from the outside world, regain mental clarity, and achieve deep psychosomatic recovery.

services.title: Pregnancy Massage (13-35 weeks)
services.description: A safe and dedicated massage for pregnant women, bringing relief to overloaded muscles. Performed in comfortable, specially adapted positions.

FaqPage.title: FAQ
FaqPage.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqPage.contactPrompt: Have other questions or concerns before your appointment? Feel free to contact me.

faqs.question: How to choose the right massage?
faqs.answer:
Choose the duration of the massage you feel like having. If this is your first time with me, I especially encourage you to book the 60 min full body massage.
Before every massage, I will conduct a short interview with you. You will tell me about your needs, tensions, and what matters most to you.
You don't have to know exactly what your body needs — that's what I'm here for.

faqs.question: How can I book an appointment?
faqs.answer:
Booking an appointment is very simple. You will find the booking link directly on the homepage.
Select the massage you are interested in, the duration of the treatment, and a convenient date — and you're done.
I do not accept bookings by phone or text message. All appointments are booked online.

faqs.question: Can I contact you by phone?
faqs.answer:
I usually have my hands full while working with clients, which is why I can't always answer the phone.
In emergency situations, if I have the opportunity, I can quickly reply to a text message.
If you have questions, want to learn more about the massage, or need help before your appointment, please use the contact form available on the website.
This allows me to calmly focus on the person currently on the table.

faqs.question: How to prepare for a massage?
faqs.answer:
To make the massage as comfortable as possible for you:

• Do not eat about 1.5–2 hours before the massage.
• If you are coming directly after a workout, please take a shower. Hygiene is very important to me.
• Do not smoke cigarettes immediately before the massage.
• Do not drink alcohol before the massage.
• Remove all jewelry — preferably leave it at home or keep it safely in your bag.
• Plan your visit so you don't rush straight from work.
• If you have an injury, health condition, take medications, or if anything happened that might matter for the massage — inform me before we start.

Come calmly, fresh after a shower, and give yourself a moment to breathe. I'll take care of the rest.

faqs.question: Do I need to prepare in any special way regarding body hair?
faqs.answer:
You do not need to wax or shave before the massage.
Gentlemen, if your body hair is very dense, I only ask for a gentle trim rather than complete removal. Shorter hair will make my work easier and the massage more comfortable.
Ladies do not need to shave their legs before the visit. You don't need to apologize for it or feel embarrassed.
And most importantly — do not apologize for how your body looks.
I am not here to judge you. I have seen thousands of human bodies — each different, each unique.
This place is for you to put down self-judgment for a moment, feel safe, and simply embrace yourself.
And I will help you with that.

faqs.question: Do I need to undress for the massage?
faqs.answer:
Gentlemen are asked to remain in their underwear, while ladies may remain in their underwear bottoms.
Your body is securely covered and draped. Only the specific part of the body I am currently working on is uncovered.
Your sense of security and comfort are most important to me.

faqs.question: Does the massage hurt?
faqs.answer:
The massage can be intense, especially when we work with heavily tense areas, but the pain should be pleasant, relaxing, and bring a sense of relief.
During the massage, we stay in constant contact. I listen to your body, observe its reactions, and adjust the intensity to your needs.
If anything is too strong or uncomfortable — let me know.

faqs.question: Can I ask for a stronger or gentler massage?
faqs.answer:
Of course.
The intensity of the massage can always be adjusted to your preferences and current well-being.
There is no single correct intensity for everyone. What is the ideal pressure for one person might be too strong for another.
That is why I listen to you and your body throughout the entire treatment.

faqs.question: Can I point out a specific area you should focus on?
faqs.answer:
Yes. If your neck, back, shoulders, legs, hips, or any other part of the body is bothering you the most — tell me about it during the interview.
The massage time is limited, so we will set priorities together to make the best use of the time allocated for your treatment.

faqs.question: Do I have to talk during the massage?
faqs.answer:
Absolutely not.
You can talk to me if you feel like it, but you can also completely quiet down.
I do not expect conversation. You can simply close your eyes, breathe, and rest.
This is your time.

faqs.question: Can I fall asleep during the massage?
faqs.answer:
Of course!
If your body and nervous system finally let go enough for you to fall asleep — allow yourself to do so.
For me, this is a sign that you have managed to truly disconnect from everyday life and enter a state of deep relaxation.

faqs.question: Is the massage suitable for people who have never had a massage before?
faqs.answer:
Most definitely!
If this is your first time, let me know. I will explain everything thoroughly and make sure you know what to expect.
You don't have to stress about anything — I will guide you through the entire treatment.

faqs.question: Do you perform massages for pregnant women?
faqs.answer:
Yes! I have a special, comfortable pregnancy pillow and a dedicated massage available in the booking system.
If you have no contraindications and are between the 13th and 35th week of pregnancy, you are welcome.
The first trimester and the final stage of pregnancy require special caution, which is why massages during these periods are not performed here for safety reasons.
If in doubt, consult your doctor or midwife about the possibility of a massage.

faqs.question: Can I get a massage during menstruation?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Menstruation in itself is not a contraindication to massage.
It all depends on how you feel.
If you suffer from severe menstrual pain or take painkillers, your perception of stimuli may be altered.
Inform me about it, and I will keep it in mind during the massage.

faqs.question: Can I come for a massage if I am sick?
faqs.answer:
If you have a runny nose, a sore throat, a cough, a fever, or other signs of illness — stay home and reschedule your appointment.
My work involves direct contact with people. If you infect me, I will have to cancel subsequent appointments.
As a small business owner, I really don't have time for that.
If you feel something is coming on, write to me and we will reschedule the visit.

faqs.question: I have other health issues. Can I get a massage?
faqs.answer:
If you have health issues, an injury, had surgery, take medications, or have any doubts — write to me before your appointment.
Inform me of anything that might matter for the massage, and I will explain precisely how we can approach the treatment.
If you are unsure — it's always better to ask.

faqs.question: What to do after a massage?
faqs.answer:
After the massage, give yourself time to rest.
Have a warm cup of tea, stay hydrated, and plan the rest of your day without major obligations.
Read a book, get under a blanket, unwind, and ideally go to sleep early.
If possible, avoid intense workouts and heavy exertion immediately after the massage.
Slow down. Breathe. Let your body do the rest.

faqs.question: Can my muscles be sore after a massage?
faqs.answer:
After a more intense massage, temporary muscle tenderness or a feeling similar to post-workout soreness may occur.
However, if sharp, unusual pain appears or something worries you — contact me.

faqs.question: How often is it worth getting a massage?
faqs.answer:
A massage is always a good idea.
The more often you give yourself a moment of mindfulness, pausing, and true relaxation, the better for your nervous system.
You don't have to wait until the tension becomes unbearable.
My minimum for everyone? Massage 1x a month.
Treat it not as a luxury, but as a regular form of self-care.

faqs.question: Can I buy a massage voucher?
faqs.answer:
Of course!
You can purchase a voucher through the form on the website.
You can pick it up elegantly packaged at the studio or — if you cannot pick it up in person — I can send you a specially generated link for the recipient.
It is always a unique gift — giving someone care, attention, and time just for themselves.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or reschedule an appointment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. You can do this yourself using the link found in the booking confirmation.
Cancellation or changing an appointment is possible up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.
Your slot is reserved exclusively for you. Advance notice gives me the opportunity to offer it to someone else.
In case of cancellation later than 24 hours before the appointment or failure to show up, the visit is fully payable and an invoice will be issued.
Please — respect my time just as I respect yours.

faqs.question: What if I am late for my appointment?
faqs.answer:
Each appointment is scheduled for a specific time, and another client may be waiting after you.
Therefore, I do not extend the massage by the time you are late — out of respect for subsequent clients and their reserved time.
If you know you will be late, please send a short text message.
Punctuality allows me to provide every client with a calm and professional visit.
